sensitivity.rule: available-period only, separately reported, never pooled into a gate

universe.completeness: no fill; a symbol/split with a missing kline, funding event, mark, rule or delist input is INCOMPLETE and excluded, never silently reduced

windows.split_rule: fresh book per split; 240-bar warm-up; no indicator, position or capital crosses a boundary; one-bar embargo and max(240,180)-bar purge for H3

execution.decisions: closed 4h candles only; entry at next executable 4h open; signal exit at next executable open in the execution-grade adapter

cost_base.fee: Binance UM VIP0 taker 0.05% each fill
cost_base.funding: actual signed rate at each funding time using the causal archived mark
cost_base.filters: historical stepSize, minQty and minNotional; quantity floors, never rounds up

execution.path: gap-open first, then conservative stop-first for unresolved 4h ambiguity; report unresolved ambiguity; no maker assumption
execution.engine_reuse: reuse StaticDataset/PIT access, SplitPlan, cost model, exchange-rule snapshots, ledger and report envelopes; add only an exact runtime-strategy adapter and rotation context

baselines.rule: 10000 deterministic matched random-entry books preserving symbol, side, entry count, holding-time distribution, capacity and costs
equal-weight side-matched passive over the same eligible symbols and split, entered and exited at executable opens with the same costs

trial_budget.rule: diagnostics and stress rows may never replace a failed primary; no result-dependent new variant

legacy_csv_context.deduplication: root results_single.csv is a superseded copy and is not counted twice; mixed-side and aggregate rows remain contamination, not side-specific evidence
legacy_csv_context.limitation: the CSV rows lack immutable run/config/data identities, so semantic deduplication beyond the explicit duplicate is impossible; all 32 named rows count conservatively as prior looks

prior_inventory.supersession: partial CORE20 packets remain prior looks but are superseded as evidence by the fuller c808794 packets; c8c7b92 parity reruns are verification replays, not new trials

gates.data: every headline symbol/split complete; no account bust; no unresolved accounting row
gates.activity: at least 60 closed episodes and at least 0.75 closed episodes per week across development+walk-forward
gates.walk_forward: at least 4 of 5 folds have positive net R; combined walk-forward mean net R>0 and PF>1.10
gates.expectancy: episode-clustered 95% lower confidence bound of combined walk-forward mean net R>0; pre-cost gross mean R>0
gates.baselines: base net return exceeds B1 and the episode-clustered 95% lower bound of candidate-minus-B0 mean R is >0
gates.stress: all-variable-costs x1.5 mean net R>0; no sign flip at 60-second latency; fees/slippage x2 reported
gates.concentration: no symbol exceeds 35% of absolute net-R contribution and top three do not exceed 60%
gates.drawdown: base max equity drawdown<25%, closed-trade max drawdown<25R, and all-variable-costs x1.5 max equity drawdown<35%
gates.multiplicity: Holm alpha 0.05 across the four primaries; report deflated/search-aware statistics with 75 prior+new strategy looks
gates.verdict: PASS only if every gate passes for the frozen primary; diagnostics cannot rescue it

ledger.future: each data access, execution run, failure and single holdout reveal appends; never rewrite or restart
